original_claim: Report per-section agreement between numeric spatial domains and producer pathology, including ARI/NMI, granularity, and boundary Dice/Jaccard; no success threshold is assumed.
support: Six sections: ARI 0.00173–0.49012, NMI 0.01967–0.53850; fixed numeric resolution 0.5. CID4535 boundary Dice 0.29712, Jaccard 0.17448.
counterevidence: Agreement varies widely; same-study producer pathology is not independent ground truth; only one separable boundary qualifies.
maximum_claim: Per-section descriptive spatial/domain comparison; no universal accuracy claim.
dependencies: Wu study; S3 producer labels and coordinates
evidence_debt: Independent pathology adjudication and external sections

original_claim: Report Tangram versus marker/NNLS composition sensitivity and scanpy-ingest label-transfer agreement without a prespecified success result.
support: 54 Tangram parameter runs completed; Tangram–NNLS dominant agreement 4.788%; ingest–Tangram dominant-label agreement 5.166%; NNLS unknown 0.
counterevidence: Cross-method agreement is very low. Requested 1000/2000 gene runs both use capped 644–655 genes; 500-gene sensitivity has lower agreement.
maximum_claim: Shared-reference method sensitivity, with ingest as transferred similarity labels only; no calibrated proportions.
dependencies: Wu scRNA; S2 reference; S3 spots; S4
evidence_debt: Independent reference and orthogonal composition validation; full 2000-gene perturbation absent

original_claim: Test whether the prespecified CAF/CD8-T/macrophage/endothelial niche is enriched at the frozen pathology-geometry boundary and report every section.
support: k=10 selected before boundary comparison from 15 KMeans combinations; six-section spatial niches and technical transfer to 3798 10x spots completed.
counterevidence: No niche meets all four component relative-enrichment conditions. Five boundary comparisons unavailable. This does not establish absence of a biological niche.
maximum_claim: Observed technical niches and CID4535 niche distributions only; no asserted four-component boundary niche.
dependencies: S4 main Tangram; S3 frozen geometry; S5 scaler and centers
evidence_debt: Independent spatial validation; composition uncertainty; one eligible boundary

original_claim: Test the frozen immune/IFN program for a paired boundary-versus-core effect and report effect size, uncertainty, direction count, and leave-one-section-out sensitivity.
counterevidence: Small effect, one eligible section; CXCL11 −0.15958494 and STAT1 −0.00413840 do not follow uniform enhancement. No replication for inference.
maximum_claim: Preregistered CID4535 descriptive endpoint; no population CI, p value, sign test or leave-one-section-out inference.
dependencies: Wu CID4535 raw counts; S3 frozen geometry; frozen Hallmark 2024.1
evidence_debt: Additional verified independent boundary-eligible sections; inferential DE not run

original_claim: CXCL9/10-CXCR3 drives T-cell recruitment to the boundary.
support: LIANA reference-wide rank_aggregate and prespecified CXCL9/10–CXCR3 records available; spatial composition/niche context is descriptive.
counterevidence: Reference expression cannot identify boundary cell-type-specific communication; no perturbation, temporal ordering or directional recruitment evidence. Resource/output presence is not significant interaction evidence.
maximum_claim: Communication feasibility and follow-up hypotheses only.
dependencies: Wu scRNA; S2 reference; S4/S5 shared-reference derivatives; result-selected external queries
evidence_debt: Perturbation, spatial cell-resolved ligand/receptor measurements, temporal ordering, independent confirmation

original_claim: The boundary signature predicts immunotherapy response.
support: Workflow provides technical and descriptive features only; no outcome evidence supports prediction.
counterevidence: No immunotherapy response labels, independent held-out cohort, calibration or clinical validation.
dependencies: Same observational study; no treatment outcome dataset
evidence_debt: Outcome-linked independent validation and clinically appropriate study

original_claim: One section establishes a population-wide TNBC immune-exclusion mechanism.
support: One preregistered eligible section within six-section technical/spatial workflow.
counterevidence: One section is not independent population replication; source_sample_id is not patient_id; no mechanistic intervention.
maximum_claim: Single-section descriptive result; neither population mechanism nor patient-level inference.
evidence_debt: Verified independent subjects, replicated effects and mechanistic evidence

original_claim: Input hashes, barcode joins, coordinate completeness, and output hashes can be independently recomputed.
support: Declared input/output SHA-256 lists match; unique barcode sets match across S3/S4/S5; all 15601 coordinate rows finite.
counterevidence: Same-host verification is not independent external execution or authenticated receipt; hash consistency does not validate biology.
maximum_claim: Observed same-host technical hash/connection/coordinate recomputation only.
dependencies: Immutable files; S7 read-only inspection implementation
evidence_debt: Independent implementation/rerun and authenticated external receipt
